resources.string: The map is dealt at random. Place your opening armies, then take turns: reinforce, attack, and fortify once.
To attack, tap a territory of yours with 2 or more armies, then a neighbouring enemy. Higher dice win; ties go to the defender.
Hold every territory of a region to earn its bonus armies each turn. Conquer at least one territory in a turn to draw a card.
Three cards of one symbol, or one of each, make a set you can turn in for armies. Hold five cards and you must turn one in.
Reach the capture target, eliminate everyone, or hold the most land when the round limit ends. Same device only, and computers can fill empty seats.
Dice games of conquest are a family of strategy games that grew from the nineteenth-century tabletop war games.
Tap your territory, then a neighbouring enemy, and roll to attack.
Holding a whole region pays bonus armies every turn.
Keep your armies together: one strong stack beats many thin ones.
